caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned slightly at an angle, with a brown wood tone throughout its structure. The backrest is shaped with a wide, curved top and a decorative, symmetrical cut-out pattern in the center. The seat is rectangular with a surface that appears to have a woven or caned greenish texture. The legs are slender, slightly curved outward, and connected by horizontal support bars, one of which is flat and positioned lower in the front. The chair sits against a plain, light-beige background. In the lower right corner, the name "David S. DeVault" is written in small, neat script.
title: Maple Side Chair
